title: Sunday Basque Quiche
description: A French-inspired quiche filled with the rich flavors of Basque cuisine, perfect for a relaxing Sunday morning.
instructions: Roll out the yellow cornmeal into a circle, about 1/4-inch thick.
In a separate pan, sauté the crumbled Sunday sausage until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk the lazy eggs and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the bowl with the whisked eggs and mix well.
Spread the cooked sausage evenly over the cornmeal circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Pour the egg and onion mixture over the sausage.
Sprinkle the French cheese over the top of the egg mixture.
Carefully transfer the quiche to a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
